8.5.4 EthIf_MainFunctionTx
[SWS_EthIf_00113] Definition of scheduled function EthIf_MainFunctionTx ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_MainFunctionTx
Syntax
void EthIf_MainFunctionTx (
void
)
Service ID [hex]
0x21
Description
The function issues transmission confirmations in polling mode. It checks also for transceiver
state changes.
Available via
SchM_EthIf.h
⌋()
[SWS_EthIf_00100] ⌈The transmission confirmation check shall be pre compile time
configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter: EthIfEnableTxInterrupt.⌋()
[SWS_EthIf_00101] ⌈The frequency of polling the transceiver state change shall
be configurable by the configuration parameter: EthIfTrcvLinkStateChgMainReload.⌋()
